name: or-info
description: CLI + MCP server for OpenRouter models: prices, benchmarks, context and comparisons
long_description: Query OpenRouter model catalog and LMArena ELO rankings. Compare models, list best-for-task, get pricing and context length. No API key required for public catalog; optional OPENROUTER_API_KEY for private/pay-gated models.
